name: q0t4
description: Weekly token budgets per repo for GitHub Copilot Chat, through the @q0t4 chat participant.

chatParticipants.name: q0t4
chatParticipants.description: Copilot Chat with a weekly budget per repo

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show this week's usage for every repo

commands.name: subjects
commands.description: List known subjects and their budgets

commands.name: use
commands.description: Charge a question to another subject: /use <subject> <question>

q0t4.subjects.markdownDescription: Weekly token limits that **override** the default for specific repos or names. Keys are `owner/repo` (matched case-insensitively) or a plain name such as `general`. Example: `{ "RemonStuff/Q0T4": { "weeklyLimit": 50000 } }`. A `weeklyLimit` of `0` disables a subject. Every repo that is not listed gets `q0t4.defaultLimit`.

weeklyLimit.description: Tokens per week for this subject.

description.description: A note shown next to the subject.

q0t4.defaultLimit.markdownDescription: The weekly token limit for every repo that is not listed in `q0t4.subjects`.

q0t4.fallbackSubject.markdownDescription: The subject for chats when no folder is open.

q0t4.resetDay.markdownDescription: The day the weekly budget resets, at local midnight.

q0t4.warnAtPercent.markdownDescription: Show a warning under the reply once this percentage of the weekly budget is used.

q0t4.dailyPaceWarning.markdownDescription: Show a warning when this percentage of the weekly budget is used within one day. It never blocks a request.

q0t4.includeHistory.markdownDescription: Send earlier messages of the same subject to the model. When off, only the current prompt is sent.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json && vscode-test --label integration
scripts.test:vsix: npm run package && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json && vscode-test --label vsix
